q: In a code language, BANKER is written as NABREK. How will STRING be written as in that language?
q_hi: एक कूट भाषा में BANKER को NABREK लिखा जाता है। उसी भाषा में STRING को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
expl_en: The six-letter word is split into two groups of three letters, and the letters within each group are reversed. Check: BANKER -> BAN|KER -> reverse each group -> NAB|REK -> NABREK. Apply the same to STRING -> STR|ING -> reverse each -> RTS|GNI -> RTSGNI. Hence the answer is (B) RTSGNI.
expl_hi: छह अक्षरों के शब्द को तीन-तीन अक्षरों के दो समूहों में बाँटकर, प्रत्येक समूह के अक्षरों को उल्टा कर दिया जाता है। जाँचें: BANKER -> BAN|KER -> प्रत्येक समूह उल्टा -> NAB|REK -> NABREK। यही नियम STRING पर लगाएँ -> STR|ING -> उल्टा -> RTS|GNI -> RTSGNI। अतः सही उत्तर (B) RTSGNI है।

q: If CAB = 12 and FED = 30, then HIDE =____.
q_hi: यदि CAB = 12 और FED = 30 है, तो HIDE = ____ होगा।
expl_en: Each letter is replaced by its position in the alphabet (A=1, B=2, ...) and the sum is doubled. Check: CAB = 3+1+2 = 6, and 6x2 = 12. FED = 6+5+4 = 15, and 15x2 = 30. For HIDE = 8+9+4+5 = 26, so 26x2 = 52. Hence the answer is (C) 52.
expl_hi: प्रत्येक अक्षर को वर्णमाला में उसकी स्थिति (A=1, B=2, ...) से बदलकर योग को दोगुना किया जाता है। जाँचें: CAB = 3+1+2 = 6, और 6x2 = 12। FED = 6+5+4 = 15, और 15x2 = 30। HIDE = 8+9+4+5 = 26, अतः 26x2 = 52। सही उत्तर (C) 52 है।

q: In a code language, QUESTION is written as OPJUTFVR. How will FACTOR be written in that language?

expl_en: First the word is written in reverse, then each letter is moved one step forward in the alphabet. Check: QUESTION reversed = NOITSEUQ; adding 1 to each letter (N->O, O->P, I->J, T->U, S->T, E->F, U->V, Q->R) gives OPJUTFVR. Apply to FACTOR: reversed = ROTCAF; +1 each (R->S, O->P, T->U, C->D, A->B, F->G) = SPUDBG. Hence the answer is (C) SPUDBG.
expl_hi: पहले शब्द को उल्टा लिखा जाता है, फिर प्रत्येक अक्षर को वर्णमाला में एक स्थान आगे बढ़ाया जाता है। जाँचें: QUESTION का उल्टा = NOITSEUQ; प्रत्येक अक्षर +1 (N->O, O->P, I->J, T->U, S->T, E->F, U->V, Q->R) = OPJUTFVR। FACTOR पर लगाएँ: उल्टा = ROTCAF; +1 (R->S, O->P, T->U, C->D, A->B, F->G) = SPUDBG। सही उत्तर (C) SPUDBG है।

q: In a code language, BACHELOR is written as SNMDIBBA. How will COHESION be written as in that language?
